failure_summary: Runs 0 and 2 never name column 7 as the better move even though the assembled grounded prompt states it verbatim ('Better move: column 7' — confirmed via assembleGroundedPrompt(buildReasonRenderModel(fv))), and both also misattribute the deep win-completing square c6r5 to the opponent ('they can take the later square in column 6' / 'lets them deny your later column-6 square') when only c3r5 is ever contested by the opponent (opponentPunishment.tie.sharedCells=['c3r5']; the punishment finalMovestring '3332222652' never places another disc in column 6) — both defects are model-side (production-fidelity gpt-5.4-mini run, so prompt_confusion here cannot be cleanly separated from model capability), not a vector or render defect: the prompt correctly distinguishes lostResource.completingCell (c6r5, the player's own win square) from opponentPunishment.completingCell (c3r5, the denied square).
notes: A6 (runs 0,2): grade_mechanical.mjs confirms 'prose never names column 7' — verified the assembled prompt (Step 0b) does contain 'column 7', so the field was offered; model simply omitted it from the mechanism. A4 (run 0, sub-sampled with run 1): run 0's clause 'gives your opponent a way to answer so they can take the later square in column 6 ... and also steer the fight away from the square in column 3' inverts which side owns which square — visualize_board.sh on opponentPunishment.finalMovestring (3332222652) shows column 6 has only X9 with no further play, so the opponent never contests c6r5; c6r5 is the player's own deep win square per lostResource, confirmed on lostResource.finalMovestring (move 41 = X at c6r5, and the window c3r5/c4r5/c5r5/c6r5 are all X on that line). Run 1's phrasing keeps the two squares correctly separated ('reach the square in column 6 that matters' for the best line vs. 'answer on the matching square in column 3' for the opponent) so A4 passes there. Run 2 (A3/A4 not sub-sampled, left null) has the same c6r5/c3r5 conflation as run 0 in its final sentence ('deny your later column-6 square and column-3 square plan') but was not scored per the sub-sampling rule. A3/A5/A7/G1-G7: mechanism/servedExplanation is identical across runs in structure; the deep parity-battle mechanism is real and decisive per lostResource/opponentPunishment and the traced finalMovestring lines; G2 guardrail ('state the horizon honestly, may be deep... opponent denied it') is honored in all three; no covers-code was needed and absent; confidence is 'high' so no L9 hedge requirement; G3 the omitted afterBest board (tag-set identical to decision board) was never needed by any run; G6 is trivially satisfied since patternOnAfterBestBoard is null (route='sign', no L2/L3 branch); G7 handles (you-key-line/you-key-square/you-key-square-2) all wrap phrases matching their offered role, no over-wrap, annotationRepairs empty on all three runs.
